questions.text: Register map: give offset, width, reset value and access of every register, including whether the shell can read anything besides ID and COUNT
questions.default: ID at 0x00 RO reset 0x53454731 (SEG1 in ASCII); COUNT at 0x04 RO reset 0x00000000 holding 8 BCD digits. No other registers
questions.reason: The request says the count is readable over the UART shell but gives no offsets, so the proposed two-register map is used until answered
questions.answer: ID at 0x00 RO reset 0x53454731 (SEG1 in ASCII); COUNT at 0x04 RO reset 0x00000000 holding 8 BCD digits. No other registers

questions.text: Is the UART test shell part of this design or provided by the harness?
questions.default: Provided by the harness; this design only exposes the ID and COUNT registers to it
questions.reason: The request names the shell but does not say who builds it
questions.answer: Provided by the harness; this design only exposes the ID and COUNT registers to it

questions.text: Is COUNT read as 8 BCD digits or as a plain binary value?
questions.default: 8 BCD digits, one nibble per digit, so the display needs no conversion and reads 0x00012345 for 12345
questions.reason: The request says decimal display but does not say the register encoding, and BCD avoids a divider
questions.answer: 8 BCD digits, one nibble per digit, so the display needs no conversion and reads 0x00012345 for 12345

questions.text: What happens when the count passes its maximum?
questions.default: Wraps from 99999999 to 00000000 on the next tick
questions.reason: Eight decimal digits is the most the display can show, so a wrap is the simplest defined behaviour
questions.answer: Wraps from 99999999 to 00000000 on the next tick

questions.text: Are leading zeros shown or blanked?
questions.default: Blanked on AN7 to AN1, AN0 always shown
questions.reason: Blanking leading zeros is the usual counter look and keeps 0 visible
questions.answer: Blanked on AN7 to AN1, AN0 always shown

questions.text: Does the centre button clear on press or while held?
questions.default: Clears once on each debounced press edge, count stays at 0 while held and then counts on from 0
questions.reason: An edge clear avoids repeated clears from a held button
questions.answer: Clears once on each debounced press edge, count stays at 0 while held and then counts on from 0

questions.text: Is the CPU reset synchronous or asynchronous?
questions.default: Synchronous to clk after a 2-flop synchroniser
questions.reason: Synchronous reset keeps all state on one clock and the synchroniser removes metastability from the button
questions.answer: Synchronous to clk after a 2-flop synchroniser

questions.text: Can the shell clear the count?
questions.default: No, only btnc and cpu_resetn clear it
questions.reason: The request names the centre button as the clear and says nothing about the shell writing
questions.answer: No, only btnc and cpu_resetn clear it

questions.default: 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit
questions.reason: The request does not state a baud rate and 115200 is the usual default for the board USB-UART
questions.answer: 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit
